permanent_product_target.uk_time_currently: 09:00 UK/BST in August 2026 (DST-dependent -- never hardcoded; see below)
permanent_product_target.rule: Never hardcode a UK clock time for US-market semantics. All session boundaries are computed in America/New_York (talonx_piv/premarket_radar.py: PREMARKET_START = time(4,0), REGULAR_OPEN = time(9,30), both compared against a tz-aware datetime converted to ZoneInfo('America/New_York')).

three_premarket_concepts.A_system_preparation: IMPLEMENTED -- startup/preflight/warmup can run ahead of the radar window; see next_live_session_plan.md Part 10.
three_premarket_concepts.C_actionable_premarket_trading: NOT IMPLEMENTED, DELIBERATELY DISABLED -- no separately researched/frozen/validated pre-market trading strategy exists. premarket_radar.py has no import of broker.py or lifecycle.py at all, so it is structurally incapable of submitting an order regardless of any future config change to this module alone.

data_sources_used: Only Alpaca's existing /v2/stocks/snapshots endpoint (prevDailyBar.c for previous-session close, latestTrade.p/dailyBar.c for current price, dailyBar.v for volume) -- the same transport/feed-param pattern session_runner.fetch_bars_latest already uses for the regular session. No new provider, no new strategy.

observations_supported_today.gap_pct: ((latest_price - prev_close) / prev_close) * 100 -- the only metric computed
observations_supported_today.data_status: READY | DATA_NOT_READY (missing prevDailyBar/latestTrade -- fails closed, never fabricated)
observations_supported_today.bias: BULLISH | BEARISH | None -- purely a label derived from gap_pct crossing +/-GAP_WATCH_THRESHOLD_PCT (1.0%, a display/dedup boundary, NOT a validated trading threshold, NEVER tuned from any observed session's outcome)

observations_NOT_supported_today_documen.relative_strength_vs_universe: not computed -- would require ranking all 35 symbols' gap_pct against each other; deferred, see production_readiness_gaps.json PRG-06
observations_NOT_supported_today_documen.developing_setup_watch_status: not computed -- would require a real pre-market technical-setup definition (e.g. consolidation/breakout), which does not exist as a validated strategy; NOT invented for this task
observations_NOT_supported_today_documen.confidence_percentages: deliberately never produced, per task instructions

event_semantics.PREMARKET_WATCH: emitted only on a bias TRANSITION (new bias, or a change from BULLISH<->BEARISH), never every tick -- PremarketRadarEngine.evaluate() tracks last-seen bias per symbol
event_semantics.PREMARKET_WATCH_CLEARED: emitted when a symbol's gap closes back under the threshold after having a WATCH bias
event_semantics.status_field_used_for: the bias label (BULLISH/BEARISH) -- NEVER 'ACTIONABLE'; premarket_radar.py has no concept of actionability at all

wiring: talonx_piv/session_runner.py's run() loop calls process_premarket_tick(now) instead of the regular process_tick(now) when premarket_radar.is_premarket(now) is true and OPEN has not yet been reached -- wholly separate code path from the regular-session decision engine, additive, does not alter any existing regular-session behavior or test.
